target: relation from 'oblong-cordate' (compound shape) to 'narrowly sagittate' (PATO sagittate, qualified narrowly)
fix: A hyphen inside a compound shape word ('oblong-cordate') joins two parts of one shape. It is not a range connector. In 'X-Y to Z' the range runs from the compound X-Y to Z.
reason: The relation was built from the hyphen in 'oblong-cordate' as if it were a range from oblong to cordate. The flora gives a range between oblong-cordate and narrowly sagittate anthers.

fix: A bare 'lobes' after 'calyx ...;' means calyx lobes. A generic 'lobes' should map to phyllome lamina lobe in the part just named, never to leaf lamina lobe in a floral part.
reason: 'calyx pale green; lobes 5' gives 5 calyx lobes. The annotation counts leaf lamina lobes inside a sepal.
'indehiscent' is correctly read as fruit not dehiscent.
'Adult leaf blade ... 55-58 cm wide': leaf lamina width 55-58 cm, with stage mature. The flora separates this from juvenile leaves.
'Bulb solitary' means one bulb.

target: apex of the stipule (scope 'apically' substituted as bearer, as for 'apex acute')
fix: 'apically X' / 'basally X' should set the place on the part the same way 'apex X' does. FLOPO 'acute (sensu botany)' is defined as inhering in an apex or base, so dropping 'apically' leaves it unclear whether the apex or the base is meant.
reason: The flora says the stipule apex is acute. The annotation puts acute on the whole stipule and loses the word 'apically'.

target: relation from elliptic (PATO_0000947) to the compound 'obovate-elliptic'
fix: Same as A07200: the hyphen in 'obovate-elliptic' is part of one compound shape, not a range. The range is 'elliptic' to 'obovate-elliptic'.
reason: The relation was taken from obovate to elliptic inside the compound word. It misses the real range, which starts at elliptic.
'mais non cordé à la base': the leaf blade is not cordate. Cordate is a quality of the base, so the base is implied.
'branches ... in age glabrous': branches glabrous, with context 'old'.
'Inflorescences ... ± globose': approximately spherical inflorescence.

fix: When a flora contrasts outer and inner segments, the position word ('the 2-3 inner segments') must fill the position slot. Without it, the quality is given to all tepals.
reason: Only the 2-3 inner perianth segments are hyaline. The outer segments are 7-12-nerved and acute, and are not said to be hyaline.
Ray florets absent.
(1–)3–11+ dm becomes 30–110 cm, with the minimum extreme 10 cm. Plant height is the normal reading.
'declinate' (bent downward or forward) fits the FLOPO value 'descending' (directed obliquely downward) closely enough.

fix: In 'Basal leaves numerous', the word 'basal' must fill the position slot. The count describes basal leaves, not all leaves.
reason: The flora counts basal leaves. The annotation applies 'many' to all leaves of the plant.
'legmne' is an OCR error for 'legume'. Fruit 6-7 cm long.
Petiole 4-13 cm, of the lower leaves. The whole and the 'lower' position are recorded.
Leaf blade apex acute; the apex is correctly substituted as bearer.
'erect-patent when moist': leaves ascending, with the moist-specimen condition recorded.
Leaf blades glabrous on the lower (abaxial) side.
The lateral united petals are not clawed. Recording 'lateral' would be better, but the annotation is not false.
The culm sheath has no auricles. 'Leaf sheath auricle' is the right class.
'margin coarsely 1-3-dentate': 1-3 teeth on the leaf blade.

target: flower colour white, or (sometimes) tinged pink
fix: 'Blanches parfois teintées de rose' means a base colour with a tinge that occurs only sometimes. It should be an alternative with frequency 'sometimes' (pattern 08), not a plain pink colour.
reason: The flowers are white and only sometimes tinged pink. A plain 'flower pink' gets the colour wrong. None of the categories covers a lost frequency word, so wrong_context is the closest fit.

fix: The Iris perianth is made of tepals (outer and inner segments), not petals. 'Segments' in a monocot perianth should map to tepal.
reason: This margin belongs to the outer Iris perianth segment (the one with the yellow crest), which is a tepal, not a petal. The quality 'dentated' for 'denticulate' is acceptable.
Stigmas 3.
Leaflet blade length 7-9 cm, maximum extreme 13 cm.
Fruit not inflated.
The dorsal sepal is 3-veined. The lateral sepals are 3- or 4-veined, so 'sepal with 3 veins' is not false, though recording 'dorsal' would be better.
Calyx glabrous or puberulous. The statement wrongly includes the buds' clause, but the annotation itself is right for the calyx.
